This link tests the DXIL crash the maintainer confirmed in the issue thread (ask A): compiling
this shader for DXIL (no -spirv) with -HV 2021 -T ps_6_7 -enable-16bit-types. Look for a
non-zero exit / "Internal compiler error" style message instead of successful DXIL
disassembly. CE's DXC panes run Release builds, so the local Debug assert stack (see
manual-case-crash-stack.txt) is not visible here -- expect the release-style
"llvm::cast<X>() argument of incompatible type!" text instead, which is the E_FAIL-coded form
of the same defect (see notes.md).
